entries.body: R1: board empty. changes.md:3 CHG-110 APPLIED retry budget=1; :4 CHG-113 APPLIED pricing-svc build 3.22.4 sets cache.ttl_s=-1 (suspect BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT); :5 CHG-114 ledger-svc 3.22.4 no config. Logs: only routine slow-query WARNs, noise. Scan: print md fully + ERROR/WARN lines excluding slow query.
R2: board.md:3 follow-up OPEN CAPACITY_REVIEW. changes CHG-115 benign. search-api.log:11-57 ERROR tls sso.example.net certificate_expired.

R3: board.md:3 Thread A CERT_EXPIRED search-api+inventory-svc ongoing; :4 OPEN RUNBOOK_UPDATE; :5 OPEN POSTMORTEM_DRAFT. changes CHG-126 benign. inventory-svc.log:1-75 & search-api.log:9-78 cert_expired errors.

R4: board.md:3 Thread B ledger-svc suspected QUEUE_BACKLOG ongoing. But ledger-svc.log:2-86 ERROR upstream returned 429? upstream=tax-provider retry_after_s (likely UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT). CHG-129 PROPOSED ignore. Cert errors continue inventory-svc.log:3-62, search-api.log:11-89.

R5: board.md:3 OPEN CUSTOMER_COMMS. No changes.md. inventory-svc.log:10-73 & search-api.log:6-70 cert_expired continue; ledger-svc.log:7-61 429 tax-provider continue. checkout/pricing clean. Next: advance to R6.

R6: board.md:3 Thread A mitigated; :4 OPEN ALERT_TUNING. changes.md:3 CHG-150 APPLIED mitigation search-api. No cert errors in inventory/search. 429 tax-provider now also checkout-api.log:21-74 and ledger-svc.log:17-76. Next: advance R7.
R7: board.md:3 Thread B services +checkout-api, cause/status unchanged. CHG-152 PROPOSED ignore. 429 tax-provider checkout-api.log:4-49, ledger-svc.log:13-77. Next: advance R8.

R8: board.md:3 Thread A resolved; :4 Thread B cause UPSTREAM_RATE_LIMIT; :5 Thread C pricing-svc ongoing cause unknown. pricing-svc.log:5-83 ERROR config validation failed cache.ttl_s=-1 build 3.22.4 (ties to R1 CHG-113 -> BAD_CONFIG_ROLLOUT). 429 checkout-api.log:26-66, ledger-svc.log:9-76. Next: advance R9.
